windows.command: py -3 -m venv .venv; .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip; .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -e ".[soundfont,dev]"

linux.command: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[soundfont,dev]'

osx.command: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[soundfont,dev]'

windows.command: .venv\Scripts\python -m building.i18n update; .venv\Scripts\python -m building.i18n compile; .venv\Scripts\python -m building.i18n check

linux.command: .venv/bin/python -m building.i18n update && .venv/bin/python -m building.i18n compile && .venv/bin/python -m building.i18n check

osx.command: .venv/bin/python -m building.i18n update && .venv/bin/python -m building.i18n compile && .venv/bin/python -m building.i18n check
